title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Running east to west, a crushed stone walkway broadens as it meets a small wooden bridge that arches over the pond toward a central island.  Tall reeds, interspersed with blossoming stargrass, cluster along the bank, framing the bridge's approach.  Beyond the bridge, fields of colorful wildflowers surround a circular building crafted of stone.
